answer_1.quote: This task involves generating concise summaries of Greek financial annual reports, emphasizing both informativeness and readability while preserving key details.

answer_2.quote: Rouge-1 is employed for abstractive and extractive summarization tasks to assess the overlap in content between gold-standard and generated summaries focusing on unigram comparison.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Beyond automated metrics, we implement a human evaluation to rigorously assess the quality of outputs from LLMs. This evaluation specifically concentrates on abstractive summarization task.
